 Bombay Coated Steels Shares Jump 16% on Debut
 By Rediff Money Desk , New Delhi 
 1 Minute Read Listen to Article 
 Share:     
 Nov 05, 2026 12:10
 x 
 Bombay Coated & Special Steels shares surged nearly 16% on their market debut. The IPO was subscribed 60.77 times, raising Rs 183 crore. Illustration: Uttam Ghosh/Rediff.com Key Points
 Shares of Bombay Coated & Special Steels Ltd jumped nearly 16% on their stock market debut.
 The company's initial public offer (IPO) was subscribed 60.77 times, raising Rs 183 crore.
 Proceeds from the IPO will be used for debt prepayment, acquiring capital equipment, and general corporate purposes.
 Bombay Coated & Special Steels is a steel processing center serving various manufacturing sectors.
 New Delhi, Nov 5 (PTI) Shares of Bombay Coated & Special Steels Ltd on Thursday ended with a premium of nearly 16 per cent against the issue price of Rs 82.
 The stock started trading at Rs 92.02, up 12.21 per cent from the issue price on the BSE. During the day, it surged 17.82 per cent to Rs 96.62. Shares of the firm ended at Rs 94.61, rallying 15.38 per cent.
 On the NSE, the stock began trading at Rs 91, a premium of 10.97 per cent. It ended at Rs 94.81, up 15.62 per cent.
 The company's market valuation stood at Rs 594.38 crore.
 The initial public offer of Bombay Coated & Special Steels Ltd was subscribed 60.77 times on the final day of bidding on Monday.
 The Rs 183-crore IPO had a price band of Rs 78-82 per share.
 The IPO was entirely a fresh issue of equity shares.
 Of the proceeds, Rs 125 crore has been earmarked for prepayment of certain borrowings, and Rs 15.7 crore will be used to finance the cost of acquiring capital equipment under existing lease arrangements with Siemens Financial Services. The remaining amount will be utilised for general corporate purposes.
 Incorporated in 2019, the company is a steel processing centre that converts steel coils into value-added products through operations such as slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing and embossing.
 The company serves original equipment manufacturers and original design manufacturers across sectors, including consumer durables, home appliances, automotive, electrical equipment and infrastructure.
 It operates manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh. -->
